findings.current: Опубликовать «{name}» в организации {destination}? / Опубликовано «{name}» в организации {destination}
findings.proposed: Опубликовать «{name}» в организацию {destination}? and Опубликовано «{name}» в организацию {destination} — same appositional name, directional head. If the team keeps the locative, keep it deliberately and record it, because the locale otherwise says 'публикация в организацию'.
findings.problem: The English destination is directional ('to {destination}'), and the ru locale's shipped wording for publishing to an organisation is the accusative: ui.agents.publication.insufficient_role.body 'Для публикации в организацию нужна роль…' and ui.agents.upload.target.orgs_unread '…чтобы опубликовать в организацию'. The new titles use the locative head 'в организации', which reads as publishing inside the organisation rather than to it. The construction itself is standard Russian apposition ('в городе Москва', 'в компании Acme'), so this is a nuance of the case, not a broken sentence, and the meaning a user takes away is still the organisation. Severity is MINOR for that reason.
findings.evidence: Composed with real shapes: 'Опубликовать «Release Crew» в организации Acme Corp?' (456.04 px at 16 px semibold) and '…в организации ООО «Ромашка»?'. The case-avoidance rationale does not require the locative: a bare nominative name works under the accusative head too ('в организацию Acme Corp'), which is why the shipped phrase can be reused.

findings.source: Publish "{name}" to the Agent Hub? / Updated the Agent Hub listing for "{name}"
findings.current: …в Хаб агентов / …в Хабе агентов (capitalised) in all four new titles
findings.proposed: Keep the capitalised surface form and record it as the rule, or align these four with the lowercase prose form the same namespace mostly ships ('в хабе'). Either way one rule should be written down; no change is required for this wave.
findings.problem: The locale has no settled letter case for the hub in prose: the same namespace ships lowercase 'хаб' five times (availability.taken 'уже опубликовано в хабе', field.name_label 'Имя в хабе', published.listed '«{name}» в хабе', published.republished 'в хабе хранится', sign_in.reauthenticate 'хаб отклонил') and capitalised 'Хаб агентов' once (sign_in.needed). The four new titles follow the capitalised sibling, which is defensible when naming the surface as a destination, but a reader can see both forms on adjacent screens. Recorded so the locale settles one rule rather than drifting.
findings.evidence: grep over src/i18n/catalogues/ru: 'Хаб агентов' as a title/navigation label (ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.agent_hub, ui.hub.pages.header.title, ui.command_palette.use_palette_sources.agent_hub) and in prose at sign_in.needed; lowercase 'хаб' in the other five upload values and in ui.agents.publication.agent_not_found.body 'сняли с хаба'.
